results.description:
A retired spy still sees danger around every corner. Her brainy houseguest - not so much.

Nerdy city slicker Violet Blackheart had been hoping for some fun - and maybe even a little sun - after returning to Beaver Island for another summer sojourn, but when a plane carrying the island's friendliest family almost crash-lands in front of her, it spins off a series of deadly events.

It doesn't take long for retired British Intelligence agent Irma Abercrombie to find herself grappling with a country club conga line gone wrong, a suspicious disappearance, and making sure that Violet's return to Beaver Island is at least a little less murdery than last year. But after a board meeting leads to some serious questions, Violet and Irma find themselves in the thick of another island investigation - and time's running out for them to catch a killer.

All Aboard! It's a whole new summer on Canada's Beaver Island...

A humorous mystery perfect for readers of Deany Ray, Leslie Langtry, and Jana Deleon. If you like silver-haired sleuths with nerdy sidekicks (and the occasional pug sighting), this is the book for you!
